description: Internal part of TmGantt (hidden from the editor): the audit-log feed shared by the sidebar History panel and the history drawer - a typed icon, the change type, the task (a link when it is still in the chart), the author, a relative time and, in the drawer, Time travel / Rollback. Place TmGantt, not this component.

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: Activity entries, newest first when rendered.

parameters.name: Tasks
parameters.description: Tasks the entries refer to (resolves the task title and makes it a link).

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Zone the times are judged and shown in.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries rendered (newest first).

parameters.name: ShowActions
parameters.description: When true each entry carries the Time travel and Rollback buttons (the drawer).

parameters.name: OnTaskSelected
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks a task title (arg = task id).

parameters.name: OnTimeTravelRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user asks to travel to an entry's time.

parameters.name: OnRollbackRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user asks to roll back an entry; the drawer confirms first.
